papers.title: SpEmoC: A Balanced Speaker-Segment Multimodal Emotion Benchmark
papers.authors: Sania Bano, Shahzad Ahmad, Santosh Kumar Vipparthi, Sukalpa Chanda, Subrahmanyam Murala
papers.affiliations: 未明确（正文中每个作者有具体机构，见第十二部分）
papers.intro: 论文提出了SpEmoC，一个从3100部英语电影/电视剧中提取、经过严格平衡筛选的30k说话片段多模态情感基准数据集，通过混合标注管道、电影级划分策略和全面实验证明了平衡数据设计对模型泛化与鲁棒性的重要性。

papers.title: Anticipate Before Acting: Future-State-Conditioned Vision-Language Navigation
papers.authors: Lingfeng Zhang, Zhanguang Zhang, Liheng Ma, Tongtong Cao, Yingxue Zhang
papers.affiliations: Noah's Ark Lab, 2012 Labs, Huawei; Department of Foundation model, 2012 Labs, Huawei
papers.intro: 该论文提出未来状态条件化的VLN（FSC-VLN），通过在因果VLM中插入未来查询令牌，并在训练时将其隐状态与冻结视觉编码器提取的未来观测嵌入对齐，在不改变推理流程和增加额外开销的前提下提升导航决策质量。

papers.title: SAMRI-3D: Adapting SAM2 for 3D MRI Segmentation with Global Volume Tokens
papers.authors: Zhao Wang, Wei Dai, Hongfu Sun, Craig Engstrom, Shekhar S. Chandra
papers.affiliations: The University of Queensland, University of Newcastle
papers.intro: 本文提出SAMRI-3D，包含目前最大规模的MRI分割基准（34个数据集、10,392个体积）以及一种冻结SAM2图像编码器、仅微调解码器和记忆模块、并引入全局体积令牌（GVT）与截断符号距离场（TSDF）重建损失的方法，在34个数据集上达到平均Dice=0.78，且零样本泛化未见下降。

papers.title: StepX-Edge: An On-Device UI Vision-Language Model via Architecture-Training-Deployment Co-Design
papers.authors: Yin Wang, Haotian Hu, Jineng Han, Wentao Qiu, Zhenhua Ge, Liujian Tang, Fanyi Wang
papers.tags: visual question answering, OCR, visual grounding, edge deployment, gui
papers.affiliations: StepX Team（具体机构未明确）
papers.intro: StepX-Edge是一个0.9B参数的端侧UI视觉语言模型，通过架构-训练-部署的三层协同设计（UI感知视觉编码、渐进式维度投影、五阶段课程训练以及模块差异化量化），在≤1B参数规模下取得了最强的UI理解性能，并成功部署于骁龙8 Gen5平台。

papers.title: Sidekick: Designing Communication for Effective Multitasking with Computer Use Agents
papers.authors: Ruei-Che Chang, Wenqian Xu, Dingzeyu Li, Bryan Wang, Anhong Guo
papers.affiliations: UMich（密歇根大学）; Adobe Research
papers.intro: Sidekick通过在不同交互阶段（后台、恢复、前台）提供环境线索、多模态摘要和推理可视化等多模态反馈，显著改善了用户与计算机使用代理在多任务场景下的协作效率和错误可追溯性。

papers.title: TimeLens2: Generalist Video Temporal Grounding with Multimodal LLMs
papers.authors: Yuhan Zhu, Changlian Ma, Xiangyu Zeng, Xinhao Li, Zhiqiu Zhang, Songze Li, Jun Zhang, Tianxiang Jiang, Yuandong Yang, Ziang Yan, Zikang Wang, Xinyu Chen, Haoran Chen, Shaowei Zhang, Limin Wang
papers.affiliations: Nanjing University; Shanghai AI Laboratory; Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Zhejiang University; University of Science and Technology of China; Fudan University
papers.intro: TimeLens2 通过将时间证据视为区间集合，在监督构建中采用分阶段证据验证流水线（TimeLens2-93K），在优化中提出基于精确一维 Wasserstein 距离的匹配自由奖励，实现了跨视频长度、领域、查询形式和视角的通用视频时间定位，并以 2B、4B、8B 紧凑模型在多个基准上超越了远超其…

papers.title: Teach it to stop, not just to click
papers.authors: Barada Sahu, Shivesh Pandey
papers.affiliations: Cabal AI; Para AI
papers.intro: 本文通过验证器引导的修复方法，系统性地评估了一个35B计算机使用智能体在五个环境中的修复可靠性，发现单次运行的评估结果被上游方差支配，并提出了k-seed报告协议和两档难度梯度结论。

papers.title: EvoGUI: An Evolution-Aware Benchmark for GUI State-Transition Understanding
papers.authors: Yaohan Yang, Minglei Shi, Borui Zhang, Jie Zhou, Jiwen Lu
papers.affiliations: Department of Automation, Tsinghua University
papers.intro: 本文提出EvoGUI，一个将规范化GUI轨迹自动转化为三类视觉问答探针（时间排序、逆动作/值预测、单步后继判别）的无额外标注诊断框架，并构建了包含3000个实例、覆盖120个领域的EvoGUI-Bench基准，对28种视觉语言模型零样本评估后发现当前最佳模型仅达60.4 EvoGain，说明状态转换…

papers.title: When Do Multimodal and Graph-Augmented RAG Help? A Controlled Evaluation for Document Question Answering
papers.authors: Sokipriala Jonah
papers.affiliations: Centre for Computational Science and Mathematical Modelling, Coventry University, Coventry, United Kingdom
papers.intro: 本文通过固定检索栈、独立消融文本/图/视觉证据的晚期融合RAG架构，在1000页PubLayNet语料上评估四种生成器，发现知识图谱增强无可靠收益，多模态增强仅在纯像素问题上带来小幅提升，且严重受图像检索召回率和生成器图像理解能力制约。

papers.title: Knowing the Self, Understanding the World: A Dual-Cognition Benchmark for UAV Spatio-temporal Reasoning with MLLMs
papers.authors: Like Liu, Zhengzheng Xu, Haitao He, Hongzhe Li, Shuchang Zhang, Dian Shao
papers.affiliations: Northwestern Polytechnical University (Like Liu, Zhengzheng Xu, Haitao He, Shuchang Zhang, Dian Shao); China University of Petroleum (Hongzhe Li)
papers.intro: 本文提出UAV-DualCog基准，通过构建多视角时空推理的图像和视频任务，系统评估MLLM在无人机场景中的自感知与环境感知的双认知能力，并验证其作为监督数据源的价值。

papers.title: MotionForesight: Re-purposing Video Models for Future 3D Scene-Flow Prediction
papers.authors: Homanga Bharadhwaj, Yash Jangir
papers.affiliations: Johns Hopkins University
papers.intro: 论文提出MotionForesight，通过重新利用预训练视频模型中的先验知识，将其从回顾性像素预测转变为直接且高效地预测以对象为中心的、稠密的未来3D场景流，仅需4万段人类交互视频即可超越基于百万级数据训练的更大模型。

papers.title: FVAttn: Adaptive Sparse Attention with Runtime Load Balancing for Video Generation
papers.authors: Hao Liu, Chenghuan Huang, Ye Huang, Zhiying Wen, Hao Liu, Mohan Zhang, Chen Li, Ziyang Ma, Jing Lyu, Jiangsu Du
papers.affiliations: Sun Yat-sen University; WeChat HPC, Tencent Inc.; WeChat Vision, Tencent Inc.; Peking University
papers.intro: FVAttn提出一种无需训练的运行时负载均衡系统，通过轻量级P2P头部迁移和松弛感知的稀疏增强，在多GPU序列并行下高效执行自适应稀疏注意力，实现显著加速且保持视频质量。

papers.title: Vision-Language Assistant for Emotional Reactions to Risky Driving
papers.authors: Harine Choi, Eun Hak Lee, Zhengzhong Tu
papers.tags: object detection, multimodal learning, autonomous driving, video search
papers.affiliations: Texas A&M University (Harine Choi, Zhengzhong Tu); Kyungil University (Eun Hak Lee)
papers.intro: 本文提出Keep Yelling Assistant (KYA)，一个将实时视觉感知（YOLOv8）与情感自适应大语言模型相结合的框架，能够检测道路上的高风险切入行为，并根据用户偏好生成人格化情绪反应。

papers.title: CLIFE: Camera-LiDAR Fusion Framework for Edge-Deployable Roadside VRU Perception
papers.authors: Tam Bang, Hoang H. Nguyen, Lei Cheng, Lihao Guo, Siyang Cao, Hussam Abubakr, Tianya Zhang, Austin Harris, Mina Sartipi
papers.affiliations: Center for Urban Informatics and Progress, University of Tennessee at Chattanooga, USA（部分作者亦来自University of Maryland, College Park, USA 和 University of Arizona, USA）
papers.intro: CLIFE是一个完全部署在单块嵌入式设备上的端到端摄像头-LiDAR融合框架，通过无目标在线标定和轻量级后融合跟踪，在53.2 FPS下实现路口VRU感知，无需云端卸载。

papers.title: VTLoc: Learning-based Tactile Contact Localization in Visual Point Clouds
papers.authors: Zhiyuan Wu, Zhuo Chen, Shan Luo
papers.affiliations: King's College London
papers.intro: 提出VTLoc框架，通过几何多模态对齐和迭代更新器，从单张2D触觉图像与3D点云中高效、精确地预测接触点在物体表面的3D坐标。

papers.title: Toward Semantic Communication for Real-time Mobile 3D Reconstruction
papers.authors: Fangzhou Zhao, Yao Sun, Xuesong Liu, Runze Cheng, Shang Kai, Yi Sun
papers.affiliations: 未明确（作者所属机构详见第十二节）
papers.intro: 本文提出一种面向实时移动3D重建的语义通信框架，通过输出重建图像及其像素级置信图，并将置信度引入RANSAC位姿初始化和光束法平差，从而在噪声信道下显著提升位姿估计精度和3D结构一致性。

papers.title: Audio-Visual Flamingo: Open Audio-Visual Intelligence for Long and Complex Videos
papers.authors: Sreyan Ghosh, Arushi Goel, Kaousheik Jayakumar, Lasha Koroshinadze, Nishit Anand, Siddharth Gururani, Hanrong Ye, Pritam Biswas, Yuanhang Su, Ehsan Hosseini-Asl, Sang-gil Lee, Zhifeng Kong, Jaehyeon Kim, Sungwon Kim, S Sakshi, Ramani Duraiswami, Dinesh Manocha, Andrew Tao, Mohammad Shoeybi, Bryan Catanzaro, Ming-Yu Liu, Wei Ping
papers.affiliations: 1NVIDIA, USA; 2University of Maryland, USA (注：作者 Sreyan Ghosh 同时标注两个机构，其余作者根据上标分属不同机构)
papers.intro: 本文提出 AV-Flamingo，一个完全开源的音频-视觉大语言模型，通过大规模定制数据集、三阶段渐进课程训练和基于时间戳的链式思维推理框架，首次在长视频理解与推理任务上实现与更大规模闭源模型相竞争的性能。

papers.title: Attention-Guided Saliency Maps for Interpreting Visualization Literacy in VLMs
papers.authors: Maeve Hutchinson, Abderrahmane Wassim Mehdaoui, Pranava Madhyastha
papers.affiliations: Maeve Hutchinson - City St George’s, University of London；Abderrahmane Wassim Mehdaoui - City St George’s, University of London；Pranava Madhyastha - City St George’s, University of London; The Alan Turing Institute
papers.intro: 论文提出一种轻量级、无梯度的注意力引导显著性图方法，通过聚合VLM语言模型所有层和头的注意力权重，直接映射回视觉编码器的图像patch网格，生成与每个生成token对应的像素级热图，并在删除测试中验证了其因果忠实性。

papers.title: How Do VLMs Fail? Vision-Operation Misalignment in Compositional VQA
papers.authors: Navya Gupta, Bingjie Xu, Avinash Anand, Timothy Liu, Zhengchen Zhang
papers.affiliations: Singapore Institute of Technology (Navya Gupta, Bingjie Xu, Avinash Anand, Zhengchen Zhang), NVIDIA (Timothy Liu)
papers.intro: 本文通过操作中心（Operation-centric）的机械分析框架，揭示了VLM在组合VQA中存在四种机制上不同的失败模式，并证明了它们分别通过前馈网络（FFN）或注意力（Attention）等不同内部路径传播，为针对性改进提供了理论依据。

papers.title: Modularized Dynamic-Granularity Video LLM for Multi-Event Long Video Understanding
papers.authors: Wei Feng, Xin Wang, Yu-Wei Zhan, Yuwei Zhou, Wenwu Zhu
papers.affiliations: 清华大学计算机科学与技术系；北京信息科学与技术国家研究中心（清华大学）
papers.intro: 本文提出MoD-VLLM，一个模块化动态粒度视频大模型框架，通过正负视频片段定位与模块化动态粒度反思的迭代闭环，实现多事件长视频中时间定位与语义理解的统一和自纠正。
